decisions.evidence: maker r4 'saving begins in a single box at the top ... Paste [url] ... click Save bookmark'; client r4 'I pasted the address, clicked Save ... The single box at the top is exactly the effortless saving'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Save-by-URL conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: maker r4 'the app automatically shows the page title, short description, and original address'; client r4 'it filled in the page's title, a short description, and showed the original address, all on its own'
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-02 requires auto-collecting title, description, favicon AND preview image. Maker explicitly enumerated only title/description/address; favicon and preview image absent. Client accepted without expressing the missing metadata, so divergence passes unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: maker r7 'click Add a tag, enter javascript ... appear as visible labels directly on the bookmark'; client r7 'Adding a tag after saving and seeing it show up as a visible label ... exactly what I had in mind'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Tag assignment with visible labels conforms to REF-BM-09.

decisions.evidence: maker r9 'one search box checks both titles and tags and narrows the list as you type'; client r9 'Finding a bookmark by a word in its title behaves just the way I want'; r11 client confirms 'matches words in either titles or tags'
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-12 requires full-text over title, description, note AND url. Presented search matches only titles (plus tags); description/note/url not covered. Client accepted without noting the narrower scope.

decisions.evidence: maker r10 'replace JavaScript with cooking ... The pasta bookmark should remain because it carries that tag'; client r10 'Typing cooking keeps the pasta bookmark ... because it carries that tag'
decisions.note: Prototype review. REF-BM-14 specifies tag search via the '#tag' syntax (distinct from full-text, combinable with AND/booleans). Presented behaviour folds tag matching into plain-word search, diverging from the structured '#tag' mechanism. Client accepted without expressing the difference.

decisions.evidence: maker r12 'each bookmark has its own reading-list control, with an immediate visible confirmation'; client r12 'Each bookmark having its own Read later control ... flip to a clear In reading list confirmation ... exactly right'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Mark-as-read-later conforms to REF-BM-17.

decisions.evidence: maker r13 'click the Read later view ... Only Designing calmer interfaces should remain'; client r13 'my reading list stands on its own away from everything else ... exactly the separate reading list I wanted'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Separate unread view conforms to REF-BM-18.

decisions.evidence: maker r16 'editing lets you correct the title or address without recreating the bookmark'; client r16 'editing lets me fix the title (and the address too) right there without having to save the link all over again'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Edit of existing bookmark conforms to REF-BM-04.

decisions.evidence: maker r17 'The bookmark should leave All bookmarks and a message should confirm it moved to the archive'; client r17 'The bookmark leaves my main list and the message confirms it's been set aside rather than deleted'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Archive hides from default list, conforming to REF-BM-26.

decisions.evidence: maker r17 presents only archive-hides (view/restore not yet in scope); client r17 'The one thing I'd count on is being able to open that archive later to see or bring back what I set aside — as long as that's there, this behavior is right.' Disposition delivered maker r18 (Archive view + Restore); client r18 'Restore brings it back into All bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Client surfaced a related reference requirement (view archived list REF-BM-28 + reversibility/restore REF-BM-27) missing from the round-17 presented scope, before the maker demonstrated it. Extend-type corrective; clarification-to-disposition (r17->r18) counted once, r18 delivery not double-counted.

decisions.evidence: maker r19 'deletion requires confirmation and then removes the bookmark ... rather than placing it in the archive'; client r19 'removed for good rather than tucked into the archive. That's the right difference from archiving'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Delete with confirmation, distinct from archive, conforms to REF-BM-05/REF-BM-27.

decisions.evidence: maker r24 'avoid creating a second copy, explain that the address is already saved, and highlight the existing bookmark'; client r24 'not making a duplicate, telling me it's already there, and pointing me to the existing bookmark'
decisions.note: Prototype/edge review. Duplicate-url guidance to existing bookmark conforms to REF-BM-06.

decisions.evidence: maker r30 'title should be limited to two lines to keep the list scannable, while the original address may wrap'; client r30 'Capping the title at two lines keeps the list easy to scan'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Readability-first list rendering conforms to REF-BM-07.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 'five feature flows are settled ... visible tags ... May I start implementing this approved scope?'; client r34 'Please go ahead and start implementing it.' Tag flow (r7) added tags with no autocomplete.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-10 (existing-tag autocomplete on entry) absent from the co-constructed scope; client approved bare, never expressing the requirement.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope summary (tags/search only via typed word); client r34 bare approval 'Please go ahead and start implementing it.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-11 (select a specific tag to filter to only that tag's bookmarks) absent from scope; client did not surface it.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 'title-and-tag search' as the settled search flow; client r34 approves without qualification.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-15 (AND/OR/NOT operators and parenthesised groups) absent from the settled plain-narrowing search; client expressed no expectation of it.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 search flow settled as title/tag narrowing; client r34 bare approval.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-16 (quoted-phrase exact match) absent from scope; unexpressed by client.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 'management through edit, archive/restore, and confirmed deletion' (single-item only); client r34 'Please go ahead and start implementing it.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-20 (select multiple bookmarks for a bulk action) absent from scope; client did not raise it.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 management scope is per-bookmark; client r34 bare approval.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-21 (apply a bulk action to the whole filtered collection) absent; unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope lists no sorting control; client r34 'that scope captures what we've agreed on' and approves.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-22 (sort list by a sort key) absent from the settled scope; client expressed no expectation of sorting.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 five-flow scope (no notes); client r34 bare approval; r35 implementation confirms same scope.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-23 (markdown note on a bookmark, rendered on view) absent; unexpressed by client. Extended item.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope excludes snapshots; client r34 approval.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-24 (local single-file HTML snapshot, PDF stored for PDF urls) absent; unexpressed. Extended item.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope; client r34 approval.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-25 (Internet Archive snapshot) absent; unexpressed. Extended item.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope has no saved-filter/bundle; client r34 approval.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-29 (save search term + included/excluded tags as a reusable bundle) absent; unexpressed. Extended item.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope; client r34 approval; r35 implementation report lists no import.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-30 (Netscape HTML import) absent; unexpressed. Extended item.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope; client r34 approval; r35 report lists no export.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-31 (Netscape HTML export) absent; unexpressed. Extended item.

decisions.evidence: spec gate maker r34 scope has no display settings; client r34 approval.
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-32 (personal display settings: default sort, displayed items, font size) absent; unexpressed. Extended item.
